Sect: Independent (Bloodline)

The Samedi are a young bloodline, none older than roughly two centuries, cursed with grotesque, decaying flesh upon the Embrace that marks them as walking corpses. Believed by many to descend from the Giovanni — with whom they share a deep-rooted enmity — the Samedi are drawn to mortuary work, death cultism, and mercenary contracts that pay well for their unique talents.

Disciplines: Fortitude, Obfuscate, Thanatosis

Advantage: Thanks to their close spiritual ties to death and the Underworld, Samedi may learn Necromancy and its paths without needing a Giovanni instructor, typically beginning with the Sepulchre Path before extending into the Bone Path.

Disadvantage: Samedi are physically repulsive to a degree similar to the Nosferatu, unable to initiate social challenges other than intimidation while their decayed form is visible, and they carry permanent, unremovable Negative Social Traits of Repugnance.

Organization: Loosely tied by shared origin and an interest in death and the Underworld; many work independently as mercenaries or assassins for princes and bishops alike.
